select s.sname 'sname', s.sdept 'sdept' from Student s 
    where sdept = (select s1.sdept from Student s1 where s1.sname = '刘晨') and s.sname != '刘晨';

select sno, sname, class from students where sno not in 
    (select sno from sc);

select s.sname from students s where s.sno in
    (select sc.sno from sc where sc.cno = '0000008')
and
s.sno in
    (select sc.sno from sc where sc.cno = '0000007');
select sno, score from sc where score > all (select  avg(score) from sc);

select Eid, EName from employee where Wno = 'A01'
and Salary < any(select Salary from employee where Wno = 'A02');
select id '学号',name '姓名',ps_score 'ps成绩' from tb_student where ps_score > all(select avg(ps_score) from tb_student);

select class_name '班级', id '学号', name '姓名', computer_score '计算机基础成绩' from tb_student where 
computer_score = (select max(computer_score) from tb_student);

select id '学号', name '姓名', html5_score 'html5成绩' from tb_student 
    where name like '%李%' and
    html5_score > all(select html5_score from tb_student 
                        where html5_score < 60);

select id '学号', name '姓名', computer_score '计算机基础成绩' from tb_student
    where class_name = '计网2003班' and 
    computer_score > (select avg(computer_score) from tb_student 
                        where class_name = '计网2004班')
    order by computer_score desc;

select  c.cno '课程号', c.cname '课程'  from sc join cou c on sc.cno = c.cno  
    where sno = 'S001' 
union
select  c.cno '课程号', c.cname '课程'  from sc join cou c on sc.cno = c.cno  
    where sno = 'S003' order by '课程号';
